jobPostingInfo.title: Senior AI Enablement Software Engineer (m/f/n)
jobPostingInfo.jobDescription:
Summary

AI is reshaping how software gets built, and we're moving fast to make it a standard part of engineering at scale. With an estate of more than 3,000 repositories, we have one of the largest and most interesting AI enablement challenges in the industry — and we're looking for the person who wants to own it.

Job description

This role is about turning AI from promise into measurable impact. You'll build the configurations, tooling, and patterns that let delivery teams plug AI directly into their day-to-day work, and you'll lead the mentoring classes and educational sessions that spread that capability across the organization.


If you're a senior engineer who loves both deep technical work and helping teams adopt AI confidently, this is a rare chance to shape how thousands of engineers work every day.


What you will do 

  • Configure repositories for AI — design, build, and roll out repeatable configurations (rules, instructions, context files, MCP/tool integrations, CI hooks) across a large and diverse repository estate.
  • Develop internal AI-powered apps for software engineering — build practical tools, assistants, dashboards, and workflow integrations that help engineering teams use AI safely and effectively in daily development, testing, code review, documentation, and repository maintenance.
